# J1 federal source list. Format: id|url
#
# Authored literals only. This file is reviewed and merged by Dean; nothing here
# is ever fetched from elsewhere. Machine interfaces only — the HTML sites
# (congress.gov, veterans.house.gov, DFAS.mil, eCFR, esd.whs.mil, ftb.ca.gov)
# are bot-walled and stay structurally dark to CI. See design section C.
#
# One source per line. Adding a source is a one-line diff, which is the point:
# the sweep must be able to say "this source changed" mechanically.
#
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
